papers.title: Pure Exploration with Multiple Correct Answers
papers.source_facts: General constrained mean-model class and finite arbitrary answer regions; sub-Gaussian asymptotic lower bound, selected minimax/change-of-measure proof; fixed-answer allocation convexity versus multi-answer union, tracking/sticky algorithm statements; Gaussian halfspace divergence calculation.

PMLR volXX is an internal placeholder, no final venue identity certified. Gaussian unconstrained halfspace formula not transferred to Bernoulli circuit models.
